title: Audit Entry
description: Structured audit trail entry recording an action, the performer, timestamp, and optional notes

performedBy.title: Performed By
performedBy.description: Name or identifier of the person who performed the action

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Date and time the action was performed

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Additional notes or context about the action

disclosure.recommendation: Audit entries are typically shared with all participants for transparency. In sensitive workflows, restrict to compliance and governance participants only.
